name: High Potential Individual visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a bachelor's, master's, or PhD degree, awarded within the last 5 years, from a university on the gov.uk Global Universities List for the relevant graduation year.
This requires £1,270 held for 28 consecutive days.
requirements.fix_path: Hold the required funds continuously for 28 days before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires English at CEFR B1.
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved Secure English Language Test at B1.

evidence_required.document: Ecctis verification confirming the degree matches an eligible institution on the Global Universities List
Bank statements showing £1,270 held for 28 consecutive days

notes: Fee £880 confirmed via gov.uk (secondary sources show £715/£822, stale). SCHEMA GAP FIXED (2026-08-08): Ecctis verification fee now formally captured via the new third_party_fees field, paid outside the gov.uk application fee. No sponsor, no job offer, no salary threshold — eligibility rests entirely on the degree and its awarding institution. Time on this route does NOT count toward ILR — this is a genuine dead-end route unless the holder switches to something else (typically Skilled Worker) before the fixed term expires, which is why leads_to_pr is false despite being a substantial, real, non-trivial route. selection_method is 'first_come' because of the annual application-year cap (1 Nov-31 Oct) rather than individual assessment discretion — worth flagging as a borderline case for the selection_method enum, since it's really an eligibility-plus-cap route rather than a classic lottery or pure first-come queue; recorded as first_come as the closest fit.
